detail.longDescription: If your program asks the user to verify a fingerprint (of a key, certificate, ...), at least TELL THEM WHICH HASH ALGO. Better yet, give them exact instructions how to calculate the hash so they don't have to google around. I am so tired of spending at least 10 minutes figuring out how to get the hash of a remote host every time there's a random key change, only to find out the hashes don't even have the same length. # CyberSecurity # InfoSec # UX # UI # Cryptography # SysAdmin # Security # DevOps
